stem: Ammonium nitrate is an important fertiliser made by the acid-base reaction between ammonia and nitric acid.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Write an equation for the production of ammonium nitrate from ammonia and nitric acid.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
The ammonia for this reaction is produced by the Haber process and the nitric acid is produced by oxidation of ammonia.

The Haber process involves a reaction between nitrogen and hydrogen at a temperature of $450^{\circ}\text{C}$ and a pressure of $20000\text{ kPa}$. At a higher reaction temperature, the rate of production of ammonia would be greater.

$$\text{N}_2\text{(g)} + 3\text{H}_2\text{(g)} \rightleftharpoons 2\text{NH}_3 \;\;\; \Delta H = -92\text{ kJ mol}^{-1}$$

The Boltzmann distribution curve shows the distribution of energies in a mixture of nitrogen and hydrogen at $450^{\circ}\text{C}$.



{{figure:visual_auto_02.png}}

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text: Sketch a second line onto the axes above to show the distribution of energies in the same mixture of gases at a higher temperature.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: With reference to the two curves, explain why the rate of production of ammonia would be greater at a higher temperature.

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text: Add a suitable label to the horizontal axis above and use it to explain why a catalyst is used in the Haber process.

parts.label: (b)(iv)
parts.text: Explain why a higher temperature is **not** used despite the fact that it would increase the rate of production of ammonia.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
The first stage in the production of nitric acid involves the reaction of ammonia with oxygen to form nitrogen monoxide, $\text{NO}$, and water.

Suggest an equation for this reaction and use oxidation numbers to show that it is a redox reaction.

parts.label: (d)(i)
parts.text:
Draw a dot-and-cross diagram of the ammonium ion. Show the outer electrons only. Use the following code for your electrons.
• electrons from nitrogen
× electrons from hydrogen

parts.label: (d)(ii)
parts.text: State the shape of an ammonium ion and give the $\text{H-N-H}$ bond angle.

parts.label: (e)
parts.text: State and explain the problems that arise from the overuse of ammonium nitrate fertiliser when the excess is washed into rivers.
